objective: LungVision AI — Phase 5D External Generalization, Uncertainty Calibration & Independent Anatomical Validation.
acceptance_criteria: Gate A: Final Test Set Independence Audit (Investigate development history of the 65-patient cohort across Phase 5, 5B, 5C; audit whether test metrics influenced architecture, loss, or checkpoint selection; classify cohort status; export phase5d_test_set_independence_audit.json).

Gate B: External Dataset Feasibility Audit (Audit MIMIC-CXR, CheXpert, PadChest, NIH, RibFrac, BIMCV, LIDC/LUNA16 for simultaneous paired frontal CXR, lateral CXR, 3D CT, and masks; document pairing availability; explicitly mark external validation status; export phase5d_external_dataset_feasibility.json).

Gate C: Uncertainty Calibration & Split Conformal Prediction (Calibrate heteroscedastic predictor using strictly the 64 validation patients; compare uncalibrated, temperature-scaled, residual-scaled, and split conformal prediction; evaluate 50/80/90/95% coverage, interval widths, patient-cluster bootstrap CIs, and failure detection AUROC; export phase5d_uncertainty_calibration.json and phase5d_patient_level_uncertainty_metrics.csv).

Gate D: Anatomical Error Stratification & Failure Analysis (Stratify reconstruction accuracy by lung volume, L/R asymmetry, thoracic aspect ratio, AP depth, rotation, and inspiratory scale; analyze top outlier failure cases; export phase5d_anatomical_stratification.json and phase5d_failure_analysis.json).

Gate E: Missing-View & Acquisition Robustness Audit (Evaluate dual-view, single-view frontal/lateral, missing lateral fallback, AP vs PA, rotation, exposure, resolution, and cropping; record valid trained vs unavailable experiments; export phase5d_missing_view_robustness.json).

Gate F: Clinical Scope, Reproducibility & Comprehensive Report (Strictly preserve distinction between estimated surfaces and diagnostic CT; generate phase5d_reproducibility_manifest.json and author authoritative PHASE_5D_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION_REPORT.md with unambiguous status declaration).
non_goals: Do not modify or retrain frozen DenseNet121 production weights (SHA-256: 8d3690cd0438587a94afb8fd2ad84c0b30f9c1cc2727ee0eb03662a02ea020af)
Do not alter frozen NIH production classification thresholds
Do not overwrite Phase 5B or Phase 5C artifacts or delete checkpoints
Do not use final test data for calibration fitting (prevent post-hoc data leakage)
Do not manufacture or fabricate external paired datasets
Do not claim clinical diagnostic validity for reconstructed surface meshes
